scoring_justification: Cannot recompute from raw simulation data because simulation is heavy; result-level compare against paper-reported gold with tolerances and structural trend verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for quadratic coefficients and strain at minimum from paper Table I, Table II, and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I (59.22, 0.17, -8.44; 65.36, 0.63, -8.39; 67.98, 1.02, -8.32; 74.22, 1.52, -8.26), epsilon0 values for (10,10) from text and for others from Table II.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper, which the reference solver also writes.

outputs.description: Table of quadratic coefficients for (10,10) SWNT and strain at potential energy minimum ε0 for all studied nanotubes, used to verify the elastic properties under uniaxial pressure.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each numeric value to hidden reference values with a defined tolerance and verifies that ε0 for each tube is negative and becomes more negative with increasing temperature. No gold values or tolerances are disclosed.
